Trade. Fight. Rule the tides.

Tide & Crown is a single-player open-world pirate trading RPG where every voyage is a choice between profit, danger, and power.

Begin with a modest ship and a small purse. Study regional markets, carry goods between distant ports, take dangerous contracts, hunt valuable prizes, and build a fleet capable of changing the balance of power across the seas.

Trade in a Living Economy

Ports produce different goods and depend on merchant traffic to supply what they lack. Shortages raise prices, incoming shipments reshape local markets, and intercepted trade vessels can create opportunities for enormous profits.

Buy where goods are plentiful, sell where they are scarce, or create shortages through piracy and disruption.

Fight Tactical Naval Battles

Naval combat is turn-based and menu-driven. Choose the right ammunition for the target:

  • Round shot breaks heavily armored hulls.

  • Chain shot tears through fast, sail-dependent ships.

  • Grape shot devastates crew-heavy boarding vessels.

Brace against incoming fire, repair damaged systems, switch ships during fleet battles, attempt boarding actions, or flee before your losses become permanent.

Capture Ships and Build a Fleet

Defeated lone vessels can be captured, stripped of cargo, or resolved through other prize choices. Expand from a starter sloop into a fleet of specialized ships, assign different roles, and recover disabled vessels after costly defeats.

Choose Your Career

Become a respected merchant captain, a feared pirate, or a political power with influence over ports and factions. Accept jobs, smuggle contraband, pursue captain objectives, negotiate with governors, and develop rivalries with recurring adversaries.

Your actions shape faction relationships, regional markets, available opportunities, and the legacy your captain leaves behind.

Survive the Open Sea

Navigate changing winds, manage crew and supplies, and travel through a day-and-night cycle. Dangerous waters conceal hostile captains, naval patrols, whirlpools, legendary ships, and creatures that are better discovered at sea than revealed on a map.

A Personal Pirate Sandbox

Tide & Crown was created from a love of classic trading games and pirate adventures such as Tradewinds and Sid Meier’s Pirates! It is designed to capture that same freedom—then expand it with a deeper economy, tactical fleet combat, evolving rivals, and meaningful career choices.

Two empires. One sea. Only one fleet sails home victorious.

Tides of Empires is a tower defense roguelite game and brings the genre something it almost never has: real, ranked competitive multiplayer — plus co-op. Defend your base on your own shore, carry the war to the enemy across the water, and prove your strategy is the sharpest one afloat. Summon warships, aircraft and submarines, build your turrets, unleash devastating abilities and upgrade them all.

⚓ MULTIPLAYER — YOUR STRATEGY VS. REAL OPPONENTS

Unleash your fleet, master your strategy, and face players from around the world in massive naval battles.

Ranked — climb the ladder

- 1v1 and 2v2 with fair, MMR-based matchmaking

- Climb the MMR leaderboard: solo in 1v1, or in 2v2 where you invite a friend and push your MMR together — maybe your two names will soon sit at the very top of the world leaderboard

Private Matches — your rules

- Invite friends and set your own custom settings

🤝 DUO SURVIVAL — SURVIVE TOGETHER

- Two players, one endless onslaught, full co-op

- Share the pressure as the enemy throws more and more at you

- Chase your best team time side by side — and storm to #1 on the global Duo leaderboard together

🗺️ CAMPAIGN — MASTER EVERY BATTLE

- Take on a thoughtfully designed, challenging campaign with various stages across three difficulties — Easy, Medium, Hard

- Demanding boss fights that test everything you've learned

- A steady climb from your first cannon to full fleet mastery

🌊 SURVIVAL — HOW LONG CAN YOU LAST?

- The enemy sends more and more units at you without end, and the onslaught keeps speeding up

- No finish line — just one question: how long do you survive?

- Push your best time further and fight your way to #1 on the worldwide Survival leaderboard

☠️ BOSS MODE — YOUR CHALLENGE, YOUR RULES

- Face towering bosses with massive HP

- You decide how many bosses to take on in a single run

- From doable to merciless — set your own level of pain

⚡ COMMAND THE BATTLE

- Pick roguelite cards that give you an edge in battle — at regular intervals, from the very first second

- Summon a full war machine: warships, aircraft and submarines

- Build defensive turrets and upgrade them tier by tier

- Unleash an arsenal of powerful abilities: lightning strike, nuke, tsunami, freeze, bombs and more

- Buy game-changing upgrades: more income, a sturdier base, deadlier turrets, stronger troops and mightier abilities

- Spend your gold wisely — every second, the call is yours: summon more units, build the next turret, or grab the next upgrade?

🏆 STORM THE LEADERBOARDS

- Fight your way to the top of three online leaderboards: MMR, Survival (Singleplayer) and Survival (Multiplayer)

- Friends system to squad up and compare

- In the end, only one question matters: is your name at the very top?

🎨 MAKE IT YOURS

- Unlock new maps, UI skins, avatars and troop colors

- Set it all up the way you like: map, fire, smoke and outline effects, camera shake and in-game hints can be toggled on or off, and the camera speed adjusted freely – plus a built-in music player

- Full keyboard menu navigation and accessible options

- Automatic keyboard layout detection (QWERTZ, QWERTY, AZERTY and more): shortcuts match your keyboard – manual selection also available

- Play in 14 languages: English, German, Turkish, French, Spanish, Russian, Portuguese (Brazil), Polish, Italian, Ukrainian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean

Raise the flag, gather your fleet, and rule the tides. The seas are waiting. ⚓

Tides of Empires is inspired by the browser classic Black Navy War — its core idea lives on here, expanded into a full strategy game.

Developed by one person.

While you were away, a jealous wizard turned your library upside down, and scattered 1,560 items throughout your library: 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions to be precise!

Match 14 book designs and nine potion types to the signs on their shelves.

Items are nicely highlighted when you point at them, making it easy for you to quickly pick up what you want to organise!

If you have trouble locating a particular type of book or potion, visit the wizard cat and use Help Me Find.

Your character becomes more efficient as you complete more shelves and you even get a fun sorting spell to help you a bit!

There are no timers, penalties or failure states. Sort everything at your own pace, save when you choose, and return later to continue your progress.

Features:

  • Sort 1,312 numbered books and 248 potions.

  • Restore 14 book collections and nine potion families.

  • Match book designs and potion shapes to their shelf signs.

  • Carry up to seven items at once.

  • Choose which items to collect and which shelves to complete first.

  • See a placement preview before shelving a compatible item.

  • Use Help Me Find to highlight a selected item type and its shelf.

  • Pet, rename and customize your wizard cat.

  • Play without timers, penalties or failure states.

Tidy Up Her Toys

Long ago, a little girl named Alice lived in a grand old mansion full of toys. Now the house is silent and dusty, and her toys are everywhere: tumbled into great heaps, stuffed into wardrobes, hidden in drawers and dropped in dark corners. Alice is still here, a gentle ghost who wants nothing more than to see her room in order again.

Step inside, take her hand and help her tidy up.

Explore a haunted mansion

Wander three floors and 20 hand-furnished rooms: a moonlit nursery, a dusty library, a music room, a cluttered attic and more. Open doors, pull out drawers, lift chairs and dig through mountains of toys. Every corner of the house can hide something.

Find 6,000 toys

There are 100 kinds of toys to collect, from teddy bears and baby dolls to rocking horses, robots, rockets and tiny ghosts. More than 7,000 are scattered across the house, so the last few of each kind are never impossible to find. Track every collection in your inventory and watch the counter climb.

Fill the Lobby of Toys

Bring your finds to the Lobby of Toys, a great hall lined with 100 shelves. Hold a toy up and its empty places glow on its shelf like little ghosts. Fill a shelf with all 60 of its toys and it’s complete.

Never alone

Alice follows you through the house, waits for you and wanders off when you stop to search. In the lobby, hold up a toy and she’ll walk you straight to its shelf.

Features

  • A cozy-spooky first-person hunt with no combat

  • 100 kinds of toys, 7,000 hidden in the mansion, 6,000 to find

  • Physics-driven toy heaps that tumble when you dig in

  • A ghost companion who follows and guides you

  • A minimap, an inventory and a toy-holding system to keep you on track

  • Three save slots, with autosave

  • Full keyboard, mouse and gamepad support

  • An original soundtrack

Take your time. The toys aren’t going anywhere, and neither is Alice.

One bundle at a time

A first-person banknote organizing game. Pick up a loose bundle, look at its artwork and denomination, and find the shelf where it belongs. Bring matching notes together and watch empty shelves become a neatly arranged collection.

Recognize it. Find its place.

The World Banknotes chapter groups notes by currency, denomination and version. Matching bundles can go into any available depth position in their designated shelf row. Learn the colors and artwork as you search, carry and put each bundle away.

Start small and discover more

Begin the World Banknotes chapter with just a few bundles. Finish the group in front of you to uncover another denomination and, later, another currency. New content opens through actual placements, giving you time to get familiar with each design.

Learn tools by organizing

Practice basic pickup and placement, then gradually learn to find matching notes, highlight a shelf, gather nearby matches and place bundles in batches. Choose which tools to learn first and put them to work as your collection grows.

Make a collection worth looking at

Explore world banknotes alongside imaginative themed designs, including animal artwork. Look closely at the details, bring matching bundles together and enjoy a shelf taking shape. Save your progress and pick up where you left off.

Sort solo or share the work

Play solo or team up in online co-op. Search for matching banknotes and divide the collections between you. The co-op world's progress is saved in the host's save file.

Pick up a skill, find where it lives, and cast it home to its shelf. Call down lightning or whip up a whirlwind with your spells to sort even faster, and watch your magical library glow brighter with every shelf you fill. Take as long as you like, because nothing here is in a hurry.

✨ 230 skills across 23 elements, from Fire and Ice to Dream and Death

✨ 15+ spells to help you sort: streak through the heaps as a comet, call spirits to lend a hand, or pull a whole cabinet over to you

✨ Toss two essences into the Fusion Fountain. What does Dream + Machine make? 253 fused skills to discover

✨ And many more secrets, like a staff that grows with you, a black cat who deals Fortune Cards, and whatever wakes up under a Red Moon...

The Essence of the Game

You take command of a tactical squad in combat. Each unit has only one action: attack, move, or play a skill card.

There are no unit upgrades here. Instead, you collect and improve a deck of cards that your units can use. These cards can be upgraded and combined.



Each specialization has its own strengths and weaknesses, so your tactics will depend on the composition of both your squad and the enemy's. To win a battle, you must assess not only how advantageous a position is, but also what it will cost to reach it.

• Enjoy a fully competitive environment with zero pay-to-win mechanics.

  • Earn Credits (C) and Experience (XP) solely through gameplay to unlock profile upgrades, units, and skins.

  • Draft Your 5-Unit Squad: Build your ultimate starting roster from 60 unique units across 4 tactical roles: Offense, Defense, Support, and Utility.

  • Grid-Based Arena Combat: Face off on dynamic grid layouts where movement, positioning, and terrain (like mountains and bases) directly dictate your range and pathing.

  • Tactical Action Economy: Manage individual unit action cooldowns. Every movement, basic attack, and special capability must be timed perfectly to maintain tempo.

  • Tile Capture & Map Control: Dominate the board by capturing tiles to expand your influence, generate turn income, or hold the central "Hill" in objective-driven modes.

  • Dynamic Status & Terrain Effects: Manipulate the battlefield by shielding allies, teleporting across obstacles, freezing enemies, or leaving toxic acid pools and hazard zones on the grid.

  • High-Synergy Counterplay: Chain devastating combos using advanced mechanics like reset-on-kill abilities, gravitational pulls, unit swapping, pathfinder bridges, and tile upgrades.

  • Draft from a diverse roster of 60 unique unit classes, including the Vanguard, Pathfinder, Disruptor, Provoker, Guard, Ranger, Saboteur, Shieldbearer, Bastion, MindFlayer, Singularity, PhaseShifter, FrostMage, and Chronomancer.

  • Build your army around four specialized unit categories: Offense, Defense, Support, and Utility

  • Counter your opponent's picks during the dynamic pre-match draft phase.

  • Balance your squad within strict drafting rules: players can select a maximum of 3 units from any single category.

  • Tailor your battles across map sizes ranging from a focused 4x9 Outpost up to the expansive 6x11 Alps (with more maps coming soon).

  • Adapt your playstyle to diverse arena layouts including Classic, Outpost, and Alps, each featuring distinct terrain formations and tactical choke points.

  • Compete across multiple distinct game modes, including Objectives, King of the Hill, Last Man Standing (with a collapsing Red Zone), and Base Assault.

  • Navigate a grid-based, scrollable Conquest Map to claim rewards along your chosen path.

  • Target Safe, Risky, or Jackpot tiles to earn XP, credits, unique unit unlocks, and emotes.

  • Maintain daily login streaks to claim bonus Credits and complete rotating Daily Missions for extra progression.

  • Level up Unit Specialist Masteries and earn tiered lifetime Achievements across Combat, Territory, Tactics, Operations, and Units.

  • Climb through 8 competitive tiers: Iron, Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, Diamond, Master, and Apex.

  • Advance through divisions (IV to I) within each tier, striving to reach Master and Apex elite status.

  • Track your global ranking and rating score as you compete against players worldwide.

  • Face off against advanced bots that dynamically evaluate the battlefield.

  • Challenge bots utilizing advanced heuristics for unit drafting, kill priorities, capture progress, defensive retreats, and tactical formations across multiple difficulty levels.

  • Customize the board using vibrant custom Tile Skins, such as Royal Guard, Cyber Warfare, Molten Core, Obsidian Guard, or Storm Brigade.

  • Personalize the battlefield with visually distinct Arena Skins, including Volcanic Core, Abyssal Ruins, 8-Bit Arcade, Zen Garden, and Grandmaster.

  • Express your playstyle with collectible Unit Skins, tactical Emotes, animated Avatars, Profile Frames, and Player Titles.

  • Analyze your strategies with a robust playback system featuring adjustable speeds (from 0.5x up to 8x).

  • Review a turn-by-turn match log, monitor real-time map coverage percentages, and track player dominance metrics.

  • Seek to any turn instantly to pinpoint critical decisions and tactical turning points.

An unknown force is spreading across the land, twisting creatures into monstrosities and weakening all metals. In this world weapons are fragile, so make every hit count.

SPATIAL BATTLES

Each battlefield is a board, filled with not only enemies, but also gold, healing, chests, allies, explosives and more. Sometimes, the environment is your strongest weapon.

FREE EXPLORATION

You are not limited to branching paths. Choose where to go, explore the area, and confront the boss when you feel ready. You won't be able to visit every location, however, so choose wisely.

UNFOLDING WORLD


Your journey doesn't simply reset after every run. Progress through increasingly dangerous regions, unlock new heroes, discover new gear and gain passive upgrades that expand your possibilities.

SIX ITEMS. THAT’S IT.


You can only carry 6 items at a time. Luckily these are not mere weapons but a powerful Relics - each unique, upgradable, and strong in its own way (even a seemingly useless “Bag full of Toads”). No deck, no RNG - your whole arsenal is always on screen.

HIT SMARTER, NOT HARDER

Your Relics will break almost instantly if you blindly bash enemies with them. But deal damage that matches an enemy's strength exactly, and you'll trigger a powerful Perfect Hit. You may need to weaken an enemy first, strengthen it, or even deliberately hurt yourself, to make the numbers line up - turning every fight into a deadly puzzle.

YOUR HERO IS A WEAPON

Heroes can be used in battle just like any other Relic. Each of the 4 available Heroes also has a unique ultimate ability and a set of dedicated upgrades.

Tilemancer is a strategy roguelite deckbuilder where every battle plays out like a tactical board puzzle.

Build two parts of your army: a deck of units that determines the soldiers available to you, and a deck of cards that supplements your units. Different unit types, terrain types and card effects interact through simple rules that can combine into increasingly complex situations.

BATTLE
During battles, place your units on a 7x7 grid and use your cards to increase their power through positioning, formations and combinations. Your goal is to find the best way to use the limited units and cards available to overcome the power score of the enemy.

PROGRESSION
Between battles, travel through a branching world filled with fights, shops, treasures, cursed encounters and other opportunities to strengthen or reshape your army. Add, remove cards, improve your options, and adapt your strategy as enemies become increasingly powerful.

FACE YOURSELF

At the end of the world, you'll face your darkest nightmare: an even more evil version of yourself.

Win or lose, you'll face it again and again.

FEATURES

  • Turn-based tactical battles played on a 7x7 grid

  • Build both a unit deck and a card deck

  • Combine positioning, unit types and card effects to create powerful formations

  • Roguelite runs with branching paths, shops, treasures and dangerous encounters

  • An army and deck that evolves throughout each run

  • Increasingly difficult battles culminating in a final boss

  • Simple fundamental rules designed to create complex tactical possibilities

Build their home. Help them survive.

TimbrianGuard is an open world colony survival game. Start with eight settlers, turn gathered supplies into a working camp, and build a place your people can call home.

From sticks and stones to a settlement

Assign roles, gather resources, make tools, and put your settlers to work. Decide what your camp needs next as you prepare for the dangers that arrive after dark.

Build block by block

Shape the terrain and use detailed sub-voxel building tools to give your settlement its own character. In Sandbox, experiment freely and create blueprints to share.

Play the free public demo

The demo is available now on Windows PC and is single-player.
  • Survival: Guide eight starting settlers through the first three full in-game days. Day-by-day goals introduce gathering, tools, camp building, and preparation for the night.
  • Sandbox: Build without a time limit. Shape the land, try the building tools, and create and share blueprints.

The demo introduces the opening of your colony. The full game and Early Access are still coming soon.

TimbrianGuard was previously called Satus; some older videos use that name.

Focus for just 3 minutes and earn a puzzle piece

A pretty good deal, right?

Time Collage is a game that supports your focus through instant feedback.

01 Random puzzle drops keep you company through every focus session

Your focus space is split in two:
Puzzles on the left, focus tools on the right

Start the focus timer on the right, and the puzzle area on the left comes to life. Every few minutes of focus, a random puzzle piece drops.

Session by session, your time takes shape as a little scene of your own.

Tips:

① Try the To-do, Memo, Count and Mindfulness tools, too.

You can move and resize them freely to create your own focus space.

② Enable Puzzle Piece Sorting and Quick Place in Settings for an easier way to put the pieces together.

02 Finish the puzzle and watch the picture come to life

Each new journey begins with a randomly selected puzzle, based on the priorities you set.

When the last piece falls into place, the still picture comes to life, becoming a postcard to remember this journey by.

Drop it into the mailbox to unlock your next journey.

Tips:

① Your focus records and puzzle progress are saved automatically. No need to finish in one sitting: take each journey at your own pace.

② A small selection of puzzles is included. Getting more requires an internet connection and a Steam sign-in. The Demo includes only a small selection to try.

03 More to discover in the game

You can:

  • Revisit each journey

  • Unlock achievements and spend the rewards on Views

  • Choose your favorite music and white noise

  • Explore detailed focus statistics

…

04 Where the idea came from

The game was inspired by the developer’s own experience of living with ADHD:

“Getting started and staying focused have always been a struggle for me.”

“I’m not lazy. I just can’t stay focused — that’s my ADHD.”

“This Pomodoro app looks promising. Let’s give it a go! (Two days later: already forgotten…)”

“These apps can track every detail, but staying focused still comes down to willpower…”

“What if I kept getting rewards as I focused… 🤔”

“What if there were always something new to look forward to…”

…

And so, TimeCollage was born.

I wanted to make an ADHD-friendly productivity game: a low-distraction desktop companion for study and work. Whether you already use the Pomodoro technique or struggle with procrastination and difficulty getting started, a to-do list can help with task management, while a focus timer lets you begin with one small thing. Light-touch gamification turns time spent focusing into puzzle-piece rewards and achievements. Instant feedback and focus statistics make your effort visible, adding a little motivation to everyday productivity.

With minimal interaction needed during focus sessions, it can be a quiet background companion; come back for a little puzzling whenever you feel like a break. Among cozy picture-book scenes, soft ambient sounds and white noise, I hope this study buddy offers gentle, relaxing company — a space with no pressure and no rush, where you can keep going at your own pace.

I hope you can redefine focus here,
and let every session leave a gentle trace.

Time is breaking. The ancestors have been called.

When reality begins to fracture, four heroes are ripped from different eras and thrown into a war they were never meant to fight. To stop the timeline from collapsing, they must travel through dangerous time zones, recover powerful relics, and survive the endless hordes drawn to destroy them.

Time Dungeons is a 1-4 player co-op action tower defense roguelike where chaotic enemy swarms, powerful character builds, and strategic defense placement collide.

Fight through two distinct game modes:

Defend
Drop into a fractured era, protect the relic, build deadly defenses, level up your hero, and hold back overwhelming waves of enemies. Every run pushes your team harder, forcing you to upgrade, reposition, and adapt as the battlefield becomes complete chaos.

Survive
Forget the safety of the relic and dive into pure arcade roguelike survival. Explore, level up, stack powerful upgrades, and see how long you can last against never ending hordes. Chase high scores, climb the leaderboards, and push your build until the timeline finally breaks you.

Choose from 4 heroes, each with their own class identity and multiple specializations that dramatically change how they play. Build around abilities, towers, upgrades, rewards, and run progression to create new strategies every time you enter the dungeon.

Play solo or with up to 4 players online. Work together to restore the timeline through a quest driven campaign, or ignore destiny completely and chase leaderboard glory across endless runs.

Features

  • 1-4 player online co-op

  • Two core game modes: relic defense and arcade survival

  • Chaotic tower defense battles with massive enemy hordes

  • Roguelike upgrades, rewards, and run based progression

  • Multiple heroes, classes, and specializations

  • Build defenses, level up, and create powerful team strategies

  • Quest line focused on restoring the fractured timeline

  • Endless survival runs with leaderboards

  • Replayable missions across different time zones and eras

Can you hold the line, recover the relics, and stop time from collapsing forever?

TimeKov is a third-person survival action game set on the unknown planet Ananke, where time is your life.

Prepare for each expedition from the safety of your base, then step outside the protective barrier to explore dangerous areas while your remaining time continues to decrease. Fight hostile creatures, gather resources, collect time energy, and decide when to return before your core runs out.

The resources you bring back can be stored, processed, and converted through your factory. Build and operate production facilities to craft charge kits, core upgrade materials, energy resources, and spaceship repair parts. Every successful return strengthens your base, expands your factory, and prepares you for deeper expeditions.

Time is not just a limit. It is your survival resource, your energy source, and the key to completing your mission on Ananke.

Key Features

- Third-person survival action where time is your life

- Explore dangerous areas and return before your remaining time runs out

- Real-time melee combat using combo attacks, skills, dashes, and stamina management

- Fight normal monsters, elite enemies, and regional bosses

- Gather resources and time energy during expeditions

- Process recovered materials through factory facilities and production recipes

- Craft charge kits, core upgrade materials, energy resources, and spaceship repair parts

- Upgrade your core to improve survival time, recovery, and exploration potential

- Expand your base and factory to reach more dangerous and distant areas

- A risk-and-reward loop built around exploration, combat, production, and returning alive

Classic spring-table football. Real tabletop rivalries.

Pull back a player, release the spring and send the ball towards goal. TinSpring Soccer brings the familiar tabletop game to life with distinctive surfaces, national tournaments and local multiplayer for up to four players.

Master ten different tables

From worn tinplate and polished plywood to warped oak and a futuristic holographic pitch, every board has its own physical character. Surfaces change how the ball rolls, drifts and rebounds. Judge the angle, learn the table and find your perfect shot.

Four players. One table.

Gather your rivals for local multiplayer using shared mouse-and-keyboard controls or a controller.

  • Head-to-head matches for two players.

  • Team matches with two versus one or two versus two.

  • Shared tournaments where you join the same national team or lead up to four separate nations.

When your nations meet, settle it on the pitch.

Chase the trophy

Lead your team through an old-style 16-team European Championship or an old-style 32-team World Cup, from the group stage to the final. Save your progress and continue later, or jump straight into a quick match.

Choose your challenge

Face computer opponents whose reaction speed, accuracy and shot selection reflect their national team's strength and your chosen difficulty. Read the play, defend your goal and make every opening count.

Full of tabletop character

Aged wood, painted metal and spring-mounted figures bring each table to life. Procedurally built boards and materials, code-generated sound effects and an original synthesized soundtrack create a distinctive atmosphere.

Play your way

  • 28 interface languages, including Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean.

  • Adjustable text size, high-contrast mode and reduced-motion options.

  • In-game controls help, including instructions for local multiplayer.

Try the free demo

Get a feel for the springs and discover the tabletop physics in the free demo, available now.

The full game is available now. Bring your rivals to the table.

Gather Tiny Resources

Every match starts with a handful of pawns and a fresh island no one has ever seen. Fell the woods, dig the gold, hunt the flock — or pen it — and haul it home. Your pawns level up as they work, and every one of them rolls a trait: a Gold Digger, a Glass Cannon, a Class Clown. Learn their names. Get attached. Send them war to and hope they return.

Build Tiny Kingdoms

Plant your castle and grow outward: houses to shelter more hands, a barracks and archery range for the fight, a church for those who'd rather heal than harm, watchtowers you can crown with a cannon. Or hand a fistful of resources to Thrak, the one goblin merchant everybody likes, and let him turn your surplus into coin.

Train Tiny Armies

Veterans walk into the school as pawns and walk out as knights, lancers, archers and monks. Set a rally point and watch your host assemble at the gate. Every soldier keeps the name, the level and the trait they earned in the fields.

Go to Tiny War!

Rival kingdoms build, scheme and march — and they play to win. Some raid, some defend, some boom. They remember the towers that broke their last wave and pick a softer target next time. Field a balanced army, each unit type has its strengths and weaknesses against others.

Be the Last Tiny Banner Standing

When a castle falls and its last soldier is gone, the whole kingdom crumbles. Take every keep on the island — or hold yours until the last banner but one has fallen.

The island has plans of its own

The Gold Rush — a mother lode surfaces mid-map, and every kingdom races for it while thieves stalk the roads home.

The Skeleton Surge — the dead rise at a place of power; who farms the bones farms the glory.

Cave Lairs — packs of venomous beasts guard hoards and rare traits. Clear the den, claim the prize.

And more world events planned!

Play it your way

Single Player against 1–3 CPU kingdoms with distinct personalities and three different difficulties

Multiplayer over Steam for up to 4 banners — free-for-all, or Team Wipeout with allied sight and shared victory

Every island procedural: highlands, meadows and lowlands, staircases carved into cliffs, forests, and gold veins — the world you admire on the main menu is the one you'll play on

In single player save anywhere across five slots, with pause and rally points to keep it cozy

Tiny Banners is a small game with a big heart, built by one developer. Every knight has a name. Try not to lose them

A Cozy Fishing Club With Friends

Tiny Fishing Club is a cozy online fishing game where tiny characters cast lines, collect fish, customize their looks, and hang out together.

Fish side by side, chat, use emotes, show off rare catches, draw, play music, or simply relax in the same little world with your friends.

Play alone when you want a quiet fishing routine.
Join friends when you want a soft place to talk, collect, and stay awhile.

No pressure. No competition.
Just fishing, friends, and a tiny club to call your own.

A Tiny World on Your Desktop

Tiny Fishing Club is designed to live beside you while you use your PC.

Your character can wander, fish, collect rewards, and keep you company while you work, study, watch videos, or chat. Check in when a fish bites, sell your catch, upgrade your gear, or let your little fishing life continue quietly on your screen.

Focus on it when you want to play.
Leave it open when you want something cozy nearby.

Catch, Collect, Customize

Every catch gives you something small to work toward.

Earn gold, fill your fish collection, unlock gear, expand your bag, collect pets, and customize your character with skins, rods, hats, bags, and more.

Keep favorite fish in your aquarium.
Bring a pet along for the trip.
Dress up, collect rare items, and make your character feel like yours.

Features

  • Cozy online fishing with friends

  • Desktop gameplay that stays beside you

  • Active play or relaxed background progress

  • Chat, emotes, drawing, music, and catch sharing

  • Fish collection, aquarium, gold, upgrades, and gear

  • Character customization with skins, rods, bags, hats, and pets

Cast your line. Invite your friends.
Your tiny fishing club is waiting.

Bring him back

Your master was the best fighter in town, right up until the Corruption Crystal pulled him inside it. Somebody has to go in after him. That somebody is you, and you are, at the moment, not very good at this.

Tiny Knight and the Corrupted Crystal is a small, chunky survivor roguelite about walking into a field full of enemies and coming back out with a slightly better sword.

Moving is your whole job

Your knight swings on his own, in a steady pulse, forever. There's no attack button. What you actually do is walk: decide who's inside the radius, thread the gap in the pack, and read the field half a second before it happens.

The camera doesn't move and the arena doesn't scroll, so everything that can reach you is already on screen. Easy to pick up. Harder to get good at.

Decide what your sword is made of

Somewhere in your first run you'll commune with the Fire Crystal, and your swing gets a little warmer. Later you'll pick up the Frost Crystal, and now you have two elements and a dial that decides how much of each goes into every hit.

Fire burns things down over time. Frost drags the horde into slow motion so you can walk circles around it. Lightning jumps between bodies and clears the clumps. Run 60% fire and 40% lightning and see how it feels. Go pure frost the next run and find out it's a different game.

Three buttons worth pressing

Bulwark plants your shield and throws everything around you backwards, with a window of invulnerability while it lands. It's the answer to being surrounded.

Bladestorm sets a ring of blades spinning around you and lets them chew through anything that gets close. Unleash the blender.

Dash bursts you a short way in whatever direction you're moving. Nothing can touch you mid-dash, and your next swing always crits.

That's it. Three abilities, on cooldown, all game. Knowing when to spend them is most of the skill.

You're not out there alone

The Herbalist provides buffs. The Cleric patches you up. The Peasant helps you collect gold, so maybe give him a knife and see what happens. None of them can be targeted by enemies, because you have enough problems already.

Five biomes, twenty-five stages, five bosses

Each biome runs five stages deep with a boss waiting at the end. Between stages you come home to town, spend what you found, and head back out.

The corrupted land chews on your health the whole time you're out there, which keeps runs brisk and stops anyone from turtling in a corner for twenty minutes. Max Health is the stat that matters, and every upgrade is really just buying yourself more time.

The town remembers

Gold survives your death, and so does everything you spent it on. The Blacksmith permanently upgrades your sword and shield, so the run where you die badly on stage 1-3 still moved you forward. Peasants haul gold out of the mine while you fight, so even a bad run comes home richer.

And then there's the crystal's offer

The thing that took your master is perfectly happy to make you the same deal.

There's a corrupted branch in the skill tree that's stronger than anything else on offer, and it doesn't just buff your abilities, it replaces them. It's a reckless road, but is it truly worth it?

ACT I - SAVE THE SHOP. BUILD THE BUSINESS.

Your father’s tire shop is now in your hands—but so is its debt.

Start with a small service shop, limited equipment and a strict payment schedule. Serve customers, negotiate profitable deals and complete tire jobs yourself. Pay off the debt, expand your operation and turn a struggling local shop into a growing tire business.

MEET CUSTOMERS AND MAKE THE SALE

Every customer arrives with different needs, expectations and a price in mind. Ask the right questions, understand what they are looking for and recommend the right tires.

Your responses affect customer trust. Set your price, handle counteroffers and decide how far you are willing to push the negotiation. Higher prices mean higher profits—but push too hard and the customer may walk away.

DO THE WORK YOURSELF

Bring the customer’s vehicle into the service bay and complete the job step by step.

Raise the car on the lift, remove the lug nuts and wheels, separate the old tires from the rims, fit the replacements, balance the wheels and install everything back onto the vehicle.

From making the sale to tightening the final lug nut, the job is yours.

CHANGE, FIT AND BALANCE THE TIRES

Removing the wheel is only the beginning.

Use the tire changer to separate the old tire from the rim, mount the replacement and prepare the wheel for balancing. Place it on the balancing machine, complete the process and return the finished wheel to the vehicle.

MANAGE STOCK, PRICES AND CASH FLOW

The right tire is useless if it is not on your shelf.

Stock different sizes, brands and seasonal tire types. Follow market prices and changing demand, order inventory and decide how aggressively you want to finance your growth.

Track sales, expenses, wages, loans, factory debt and upcoming payment deadlines from your shop computer.

Running out of stock can cost you a customer. Taking on too much debt can cost you the business.

BUY STOCK BEFORE YOU NEED IT

Demand changes throughout the year, and every tire sitting on your shelf is money tied up in inventory.

Watch tire sizes, seasonal demand and market prices. Order ready stock when you need inventory quickly or plan ahead for future deliveries.

Choose between paying immediately or using deferred factory payments—but every financial shortcut creates another deadline.

GROW FROM A SMALL SHOP

Reinvest your profits into better equipment and additional service capacity.

Upgrade your tools, tire changers and balancing machines. Open additional service bays, hire mechanics and increase the number of vehicles your business can handle.

As the shop grows, managing the workflow becomes just as important as doing the work yourself.

HIRE MECHANICS AND MANAGE THE WORKFLOW

You will not be able to do everything yourself forever.

Hire mechanics to help with service work and expand the number of jobs your shop can handle. Better employees cost more, but a stronger team allows the business to serve more customers at the same time.

ACT II - TAKE ON COMPANY CONTRACTS

Move beyond individual customers and start servicing company fleets.

Accept multi-vehicle contracts, prepare the required inventory and complete each vehicle before the deadline.

Larger contracts bring larger payouts and bonuses—but failing to prepare enough stock or finish the work on time can turn an opportunity into a financial loss.

ACT III - ENTER THE WHOLESALE MARKET

A successful tire shop is only the beginning.

Build a dedicated wholesale operation, purchase tires in bulk and supply other tire businesses.

Start with local orders and gradually move toward larger customers and national distribution. Larger orders can generate far greater profits, but they demand more inventory, more working capital and much stronger planning.

YOUR SHOP. YOUR PRICES. YOUR FUTURE.

Tire Dealer Simulator combines hands-on first-person tire service with customer negotiation, inventory planning and long-term business management.

Start by fighting to save a debt-ridden family shop.

Build your inventory. Learn the market. Expand your service capacity. Hire a team. Take on larger contracts and push the business beyond retail.

How far the shop grows is up to you.

Save the family shop. Build the business. See how far you can take it.

Topdeck Duel is an addictive card roguelike with incremental elements. Test your luck and tactical thinking as your main goal is to claim the opponent's entire deck and beat 10 challenging levels. Every drawn card can turn the tide of battle!

⚔️ SIMPLE RULES, HIGH STAKES

The core of combat is familiar to everyone: you and your opponent simultaneously draw the top card. The one with the higher power takes both. But if the power is equal, a "War" begins: players draw additional cards face down and face up, raising the stakes to the limit!

🧩 SMART POSITIONING & DEEP TACTICS

Once you collect enough cards, you enter the Arrangement phase, where you draw random cards from your discard pile and place them on a 6-slot board. This is your chance to turn the game around:

  • Each card has its own unique effect that allows you to increase the power of the cards on the table.

  • Your cards provide you with buffs, increasing card power:

  • But when you claim enemy cards, their effects flip 180 degrees—instead of buffs, they inflict debuffs on you, reducing card power:

  • Card effects depend on their position, neighbors, enemy cards, or even active debuffs.

  • Position your cards wisely to maximize buffs and minimize debuffs.

  • It's impossible to calculate the perfect combo in advance—you have to adapt on the fly.

  • Use unique tactical abilities: Reroll unwanted cards, Swap their positions on the board, or use Predict to peek at the opponent's future moves!

🔥 INFLUENCE MANAGEMENT

Placing and manipulating cards costs a special resource: Influence. If you position your cards suboptimally, an exhausting tug-of-war will begin, quickly draining your reserves. Once your Influence drops to zero, your run is over.

🃏 MERGING & CRAFTING THE PERFECT DECK

After defeating an enemy, you claim a part of their deck permanently. But be careful, the captured cards are still considered enemy cards and provide debuffs. You also unlock the following options:

  • Merge 3 identical cards into one of a higher rarity (from Common to Legendary) to get a card with a stronger effect:

  • Burn unwanted cards for Influence.

📈 INCREMENTAL PROGRESSION

Lost? No problem! Every attempt makes you stronger. Gold earned in battles is kept permanently. Spend it on global meta-upgrades between runs:

  • Tactics: Unlock new board management abilities.

  • Economy: Increase your Influence reserves.

  • Deckbuilding: Start the game with higher rarity cards, claim more trophies, and improve card alchemy.

Start small, adapt your strategy, hoard gold, and become the ultimate master of Topdeck Duel!

Touhou Bansho Cards is a deckbuilding roguelite built around explosive, satisfying combat.
Play as Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, or Sanae Kochiya and explore the anomaly known as the Bansho Card Corridor. Collect Spell Cards and dice, then build the strongest, fiercest deck you can through a constant stream of random events and challenges. Blast apart the enemies lurking within with earth-shattering power and rescue the girls of Gensokyo.

Combat That Escalates Fast

Play cards of the same type back-to-back to keep raising your Combo, repeatedly doubling the values and effects of the next card. Weave in Link cards to switch Combo types, stacking damage, defense, buffs, and enemy debuffs throughout a fight until an ordinary strike erupts into an all-out burst!

Endless Combos, Explosive Scaling

Push Combos, Criticals, and repeated plays to their limits. Stack them with all kinds of boosts and unleash the strongest, fiercest Spell Card you can build, until the entire battle goes completely out of control!

Build World-Shattering Spell Card Combos

Events throughout the Corridor keep reshaping your run. Upgrade, enhance, and trim your deck through all kinds of events, making your build hundreds, even thousands of times stronger!

Never Underestimate the Power of Bonds!

Defeat the echoes and bring the girls of Gensokyo back home. Spend time with them, deepen your bonds, gain their support and new powers, then carry that strength with you as you venture deeper into the Bansho Card Corridor.

Game Features

  • Play cards of the same type back-to-back, build your Combo higher, and make every card that follows hit harder.

  • Collect Spell Cards and dice, reshape your deck through events, and fuse cards into devastating combinations.

  • Explore the ever-changing Bansho Card Corridor, with different events, rewards, and challenges on every run.

  • Play as Reimu Hakurei, Marisa Kirisame, or Sanae Kochiya, each with their own abilities.

  • Defeat echoes, rescue the girls of Gensokyo, and gain new support and powers through your bonds.

There won’t be a moon-viewing party at Hakurei Shrine this year.

The Scarlet Devil Mansion keeps growing taller in the distance, spoiling the view from the shrine’s courtyard. Reimu has lost her enthusiasm for hosting the party, but Tenshi, who has already brought the sake, isn’t ready to call it off. If the view is no good down here, why not take the party higher than anyone else?

So she builds herself a flying pleasure cruiser, brings aboard tables, chairs, and sake, and starts welcoming guests from far and wide.

Build a Boat, One Room at a Time

Add kitchens, dining areas, guest rooms, and entertainment facilities, expanding your boat room by room. Build outward and upward, connect walkways, and leave terraces where guests can relax and enjoy the view.

Rearrange rooms to suit your business, and gradually turn your little boat into something of your own.

Welcome Guests Above the Clouds

Once aboard, guests follow their own routines: eating, shopping, resting, and finding ways to pass the time. Some settle down to watch a performance, while others wander the corridors. On clear nights, the rooftops become a place to admire the moon.

Stock up on ingredients and merchandise, arrange the services on board, and watch guests come and go between facilities. Then put the earnings from each voyage toward new rooms.

From One Stop to the Next

Choose your next destination, replenish your supplies, welcome new guests, and carry them onward.

Each destination has its own guests and goods. Dock, shop, stop for a chat, then return aboard to keep your business running. You can also invite characters such as Reimu and Remilia along and hear what they think of the trip.

The venue in the sky is ready, but the moon-viewing party at the shrine is still unsettled. As Tenshi carries her guests from place to place, she keeps working on getting that party going.

Forge Your Defense

Every tower in TowOrbs follows a distinct playstyle: Frozen, Lightning, Fire, Shadow, Poison, Physical, Support, Chaos, and the mysterious Glyph. Each offers its own devastating abilities and unique upgrades. Freeze enemies in their tracks, ignite the battlefield, spread deadly corruption through entire hordes, or unleash chain lightning that tears through wave after wave.

Build Your Way

No two defenses are ever the same.

Every battle makes you stronger. Earn skill points, expand your skill tree, and unlock powerful passives, endless upgrades, and capstone abilities that can completely reshape your strategy.

Survive the Onslaught

The campaign is only the beginning.

Step into Onslaught, where every kill makes the enemy stronger and every wave pushes your build closer to its breaking point. The hordes never stop coming. How long can your defenses hold before they're finally overwhelmed?

Features

  • Unique tower paths, each with its own abilities, upgrades, Mastery, and Prestige progression

  • 50+ handcrafted stages with unique layouts and challenges

  • Dynamic orb drops that strengthen your towers during battle

  • Deep skill tree filled with powerful passives and capstone abilities

  • Tower Mastery and player progression that unlock new possibilities

  • Endless Onslaught mode with infinite enemies

    If you would like to contact me about this game feel free to message @Exaltes on Discord or you can E-Mail me at: Exaltes123@yahoo.com

Tower of Annihilation: Welcome to Hell is a cursed roguelite hex-based dungeon-crawler where the only way to escape eternal damnation is to die repeatedly in a seemingly endless tower that corrupts and consumes those who try to climb it.

Fight your way upward through deadly floors filled with monsters, obstacles, and temptation. Gather gear, shape your build, and lead damned souls into battle as you push deeper into the Tower’s mysteries. Between climbs, return to the base to recover, upgrade, prepare, and decide how many of your resources to gamble on the next run. 

The Tower is not just a prison. - it is a test, a weapon, and a path toward redemption and apotheosis. Every climb offers risks, rewards, and the risk of being changed by choices you make.

Will you escape damnation through defeating the tower's monsters, or become corrupted by its curse?

Features:

  • Climb the Tower of Annihilation stretching from Hell toward Earth

  • Roguelite progression with repeated runs, growing power, and hard choices

  • Tactical turn-based combat focused on positioning, planning, and survival

  • Set waypoints and stack intent for autonomous synchronized maneuvers

  • Recruit and manage damned souls to strengthen your party

  • Build and equip your team with weapons, armor, abilities, and resources

  • Return to the City of Ash between runs to prepare for the next ascent

  • Risk corruption, chase redemption, and uncover the Tower’s secrets

    This game has an early-alpha demo created for Steam's NextFest event. It was created by the developer solo as their first game with the help of chatgpt. All graphics and music are temporary placeholders pending the ability to fund human art. If you find the game promising, please consider supporting development to help it achieve this apotheosis.

Hey, Driver! The city is in your way.

A chaotic top-down driving game where finding the fastest route is only half the battle. Navigate busy streets, squeeze through tight gaps, and find your way across town.

And then... CHICKENS.

Because apparently traffic wasn't enough.

Think you've got the route?

Find shortcuts. Master the streets. Beat your best time.

...Until!

Unpredictable obstacles can turn a perfect run into complete chaos.

Key Features

  • 30 action-packed levels.

  • 6 unique cars, each with their own speed and handling.

  • Chickens on the road, avoid them, or lose a life.

  • Dynamic obstacles, challenges, and traffic to overcome.

  • Earn Stars, finish faster to earn up to 3 stars, or just cruise to the goal.

Choose your way to play

  • Campaign Mode: Race through levels with a timer, earn stars, and climb the leaderboard.

  • Free Roam Mode: Complete levels at your own pace without time pressure.

Whether you’re hunting for the fastest time or just looking to blow off steam dodging chickens, Town Crazy has a mode for you.

I’m a solo developer and your feedback helps shape the full release.

TOWN HALL is a first-person game about the last working desk in a town that is closing. One municipal building, rendered in full 3D; a rubber stamp; and a line of people who all need something to be officially true.

You are the town clerk. The mayor is unreachable, the other offices are dark, and the seal on your desk still works — which makes you, in every way that counts, the government.

Whatever you stamp becomes true

Permits. Licenses. Certificates of birth, of death, of ownership. The paper in front of you is a claim; your stamp is the fact. Approve it, and the town reshapes itself around your signature. Refuse it, and the person in front of you goes home to live in the version of the town you just chose for them.

Everyone brings a reason. Most bring money.

Your salary is late. The building's heating is a line item nobody pays. A folded bill inside a folder is not a bribe if nobody says the word — and your reputation moves with every desk decision, in a town small enough to remember all of them.

Walk out and see what you signed

The desk is not the whole game. Step out to the town map and visit what your stamps did — the reopened bar, the condemned house, the pier that is suddenly private property. Every room is built to be searched: drawers, ledgers, notes, the things people leave behind when they think an office is just an office.

The basement remembers

Below the archive there is a file about why this town emptied. Nobody asks you to read it. The keys to it pass across your desk one favor at a time.

What you get

  • A first-person 3D town you can walk, built around one municipal building
  • Choices that commit — a stamp cannot be unpressed, and the town keeps the receipts
  • A money and reputation loop where every convenience has a price and a witness
  • No combat. The most dangerous thing in this town is a signature — yours
  • Eleven languages · offline · single-player · no account, no telemetry

TOWN HALL contains pre-generated AI content. Its environment art and character models are created with generative image and image-to-3D tools, composed, programmed and finished by hand; its store artwork comes from the same pipeline. Its narrative text is human–AI co-written and human-edited under the author's direction; the game design is the author's. Its music and sound are created with generative audio tools. No AI content is generated at runtime, and the game contains no AI-generated depictions of real people.

Ancak algoritma ona acımadı. Yaşam tarzları ve kafaları Atakan ile o kadar uyumsuz 3 kadınla eşleşti ki... Toksiklik artık kaçınılmaz!

Sinemanın Altın Kuralını Unutun: "Anlat, Gösterme"

Görsel sanatların o meşhur "Göster, anlatma" kuralını unutun. Bu oyun, kuralları ters düz ediyor! Bizim mottomuz: "Anlat, gösterme!"

Atakan’ın kaotik, panik ve mizahla dolup taşan iç ses mekaniğiyle, interaktif sinematik anlatımda kuralları yeniden yazan, yepyeni bir tarz deniyoruz.

Oyun Özellikleri

  • 3 Farklı Karakter: Resim öğretmeni Selin'den başlayıp, muhafazakar Meryem'e, iş kadını Yasemin'e uzanan randevular.

  • Ya Olduğun Gibi Seç, Ya Seçtiğin Gibi Ol: Verdiğin kararlardaki tutarlılığa göre Kılıbık, Alfa, Pinokyo, Manipülatör, Dürüst gibi  kişilik özellikleri kazan.   • Randevu Sonu Acı Gerçekler: Randevu bittiğinde skorunla yüzleş. Yaptığın seçimlere göre komik ve acı ünvanlardan birini kap. İlişkinin kısa ve uzun vadedeki felaket senaryolarını oku ve vicdanınla muhakeme yap.

Toy Box is a retro-style arcade maze game where players  assume the role of Aoy who must collect scattered toys throughout colorful worlds and return them safely to the toy chest while avoiding enemies, hazards, and the mysterious Xob.

Each round challenges players to explore the maze, gather toys one at a time, and unlock the exit before danger closes in. But be careful — the longer you take, the greater the chance that Xob will appear to hunt you down!

Use powerful items to defend yourself against Enemies, while collecting treats, popping balloons, and chasing high scores across fast-paced arcade action.

With classic arcade-inspired gameplay, colorful toy-themed worlds, bonus rounds, and rewarding score mechanics, Toy Box delivers a fun and challenging experience for both casual players and score-chasing arcade fans.

Can you collect every toy and escape the Toy Box?

Key Features

  • Retro-inspired arcade maze gameplay

  • Explore 15 unique levels across 5 colorful themed worlds

  • Use silly power-ups to defend yourself

  • Collect bonus treats to maximize your score streaks

  • Unlock bonuses by popping all balloons

  • Fast-paced gameplay focused on score chasing and replayability

  • Family-friendly fun with colorful toybox visuals

Tiny Agents. Giant Trouble.

A tiny squad. A massive world. One mission that goes completely off the rails.

In ToyOps, take control of a rookie squad of toy agents on their very first field mission. Infiltrate enemy territory, overcome dangerous obstacles, and use each agent's unique abilities to complete your mission.

From a toy's perspective, ordinary rooms become enormous playgrounds filled with towering furniture, mysterious machinery, and unexpected dangers. What seems like an everyday object to a human could be the key to your next breakthrough—or the obstacle standing in your way.

Small Size. Big Challenges.

Run, jump, slide, and navigate your way through a world built for humans, not toys.

Leap across oversized platforms, slip through narrow passages, and carefully avoid deadly traps and enemy detection as you venture deeper into hostile territory.

Every environment brings new challenges that test your reflexes, timing, and ability to find a way forward.

Different Agents. Different Possibilities.

Every toy agent has their own movement style, special abilities, and strengths.

Switch between squad members, use teleportation and unique movement abilities to reach otherwise inaccessible areas, and discover new ways to overcome obstacles.

The same challenge can look completely different depending on which agent you choose.

Sometimes, the solution isn't about jumping farther—it's about choosing the right agent.

Think Small. Solve Big.

In a world where everyday objects tower above you, almost anything could become part of a puzzle.

Interact with objects, manipulate mechanisms, and use the environment to your advantage. Combine your agents' abilities with creative thinking to solve environmental puzzles and navigate challenging platforming sequences.

Look closely, experiment, and discover how seemingly ordinary objects can open up extraordinary possibilities.

First Mission. Nothing Goes as Planned.

They've trained to become secret agents. But training is one thing. Surviving a real mission is another.

What begins as a routine assignment quickly spirals into an unexpected crisis. Separated from the safety of their training, this inexperienced squad must face dangerous enemies, unpredictable challenges, and a mission that is rapidly slipping out of control.

They may be small, inexperienced, and completely unprepared for what's coming.

But even the smallest agents can make a big difference.

Run a medieval shop stocked with goods recovered from dangerous dungeons. Arrange your stock, serve unusual customers, and decide which deals are worth the risk. The boss sets the rules, and some goods may be forbidden.

Enter the dungeon after dark to search for valuable loot. Open locked chests, avoid traps, hide from enemies, and escape with what you can carry. Inventory space is limited, so every piece of loot matters.

The boss expects regular payments. Make enough profit before the deadline—or face the consequences. Sell by day. Loot by night. Pay what you owe.

PROFIT OR PLAY IT SAFE

Selling forbidden goods can earn you more gold, but illegal business comes with consequences. Follow the boss’s rules for a safer life, or break them to increase your profits—and the danger surrounding your shop.

Spend your earnings on upgrades that help you carry more loot, open better locks, and discover new ways to recover valuable items.

FEATURES

  • First-person shopkeeping and dungeon exploration

  • A day-and-night gameplay loop

  • Physical items and limited inventory space

  • Dangerous traps, enemies, locked chests, and hiding spots

  • Legal and forbidden goods with different risks

  • Shop, equipment, and exploration upgrades

  • A dark medieval atmosphere combining cozy trading with dungeon tension

Are You Ready to Leave Your Mark on the Asphalt?Traffic Monster is a high-speed, adrenaline-fueled casual racing experience where you will push your reflexes to the limit. Forget ordinary driving games; here, speed, skill, and courage set the rules! Dive into heavy traffic, weave between cars, push the limits by driving in the wrong lane, and show everyone who the biggest monster on the asphalt is.

Boundary-Pushing Gameplay Just stepping on the gas isn't enough! The "Near Miss" and "Wrong Way" bonuses you earn by narrowly dodging vehicles and driving in the oncoming lane will multiply your score. You have no room for error. Race against time and increasingly difficult traffic to break your own records.

Rule Your Garage, Reflect Your Style Open the doors to your massive garage using the rewards you earn in-game. Unlock vehicles, each with different dynamics, and modify them from top to bottom:

  • Performance Upgrades: Take your vehicle's speed, acceleration, and braking power to the next level.

  • Visual Customization: Paint the vehicle body, rims, and window tints exactly to your taste. Stand out on the roads not just with your speed, but with your style. (To be detailed with updates and new customizations will be added)

Game-Changing Power-Ups When you're stuck in traffic or want to multiply your score, game-changing power-ups await you:

  • Nitro: Reach uncontrollable speeds and make the asphalt cry like a true monster.

  • 2x Point: More rewards mean more money.

  • Shield: Protect yourself with your shield and clear all vehicles in your path.

  • Slow Motion: Navigate through the tightest gaps by slowing down time.

  • Jump: Prove nothing can stop you by jumping over cars.

  • Fear: Strike fear into all cars with a loud roar and make them run for cover.

  • Rage Mode: When you get angry, you recognize no obstacles.

Online Competition and Bet System You don't have to settle for just your own records. Enter online races and test your skills against real players!

  • Create Private Rooms: Create password-protected rooms to play with your friends, or challenge everyone in public rooms.

  • Bet System: Join races not just for honor, but for the bets you place. Remember, being in the front isn't what brings you victory; taking risks to get the highest score does.

Are you the monster of the traffic? Get behind the wheel and prove it!

TURN MESS INTO A SYSTEM

You have bought a bankrupt recycling yard. It has one gate, no machines, no staff, and a garbage truck that keeps arriving whether you are ready or not.

Start on the ground floor of the waste business: tear open bags, pick up loose materials, and carry every item to the right destination yourself. Then invest your earnings in workers, machines, conveyors, containers, and upgrades until the same chaotic yard runs like a well-oiled recycling operation.

GET YOUR HANDS DIRTY

Before a job can be automated, you do it by hand. Open incoming bags, collect scattered waste, and decide where each material belongs. Improve your reach and carrying capacity to clear deliveries faster and keep hands-on play useful as the facility grows.

BUILD THE FLOW

Install processing machines and connect each stage with conveyors. Materials physically travel through the yard—from the first machine to the next stage and finally into the correct container. Upgrade capacity and processing speed, remove bottlenecks, and turn visible clutter into a satisfying production flow.

PUT A CREW TO WORK

Hire workers to open bags and carry materials across the yard. Improve their speed, capacity, qualifications, work time, and recovery. As the crew develops, workers become visibly more capable and help transform manual sorting into a coordinated operation.

KEEP THE YARD MOVING

Trash does not disappear into a menu. Deliveries occupy real space, workers walk to their jobs, machines fill up, and overloaded areas can slow the entire facility. Balance incoming trucks against worker throughput, machine speed, and container capacity to keep the system moving.

FEATURES

- A hands-on recycling loop that gradually becomes automated

- Workers who physically collect and carry waste through the yard

- Multi-stage processing machines connected by visible conveyors

- Upgrades for the player, crew, trucks, machines, and containers

- Multiple waste categories with their own processing chains

- Clear on-screen progression from a struggling yard to an efficient facility

- Relaxed incremental management with meaningful bottlenecks to solve

- Colorful 2D pixel-art gameplay viewed from a top-down perspective

A little adventure, right alongside your everyday PC life.
Traymon World is an idle monster RPG that lives on your taskbar.
Grow your party and explore while you work, study, or browse.

84 monsters, each a new beginning

Hatch and collect 84 monsters and fill your own collection.

Three companions. Your own strategy.

Build a 3-monster party and make the most of element, family, and role synergies.

Make every monster your own

Individual stats, color variants, and random talent combinations give monsters of the same species different ways to grow.

Explore, battle, and bring something home

Explore varied fields and regions, and challenge bosses. Obtain eggs, equipment, and resources on your adventure to grow your party.

Trade on the Steam Community Market

Trade monsters, equipment, and appraised eggs on the Steam Community Market.

A Fully Open World

Explore a rich and immersive world with complete freedom. Haggle with grumpy street vendors, browse valuable treasures in reputable antique stores, uncover hidden gems in second-hand shops, or cautiously acquire mysterious goods from the black market. Travel across different regions in search of opportunities that can bring you fortune and success. And when business slows down, relax and enjoy yourself at the local tavern.

Negotiation & Character Growth

Negotiation is an art. Adapt your bargaining strategy to customers with different personalities. Will you push for a better deal at the risk of losing the transaction, or settle for a reasonable profit? Will you deceive customers for massive gains, or build a reputation through honest business practices? Your choices will directly determine the success or failure of your shop. Gain experience through every transaction, unlock new skills, and gradually grow into a master negotiator.

Shop Management & Hiring

Purchase display cases of varying quality according to your financial situation and decorate your shop with valuable artifacts to increase its appeal and transaction value. Expand your business as it grows, customize the appearance of your storefront, and create a shop that reflects your personal style. Hire assistants to help manage daily operations, automate transactions, catch thieves, and handle unexpected situations.

Story Campaign

A tense conflict between government forces and rebels has engulfed the local town. Visitors from both factions will frequently come to your shop seeking assistance. Satisfy their requests to ensure your survival, and when the time comes, choose a side. Your decision will shape the course of the story and lead to one of several unique endings.

Treasure

Choose from nearly a thousand unique collectibles and antiques. Carefully inspect and evaluate each item to uncover its hidden value and investment potential. Personally perform appraisal, restoration, forgery, and other specialized operations. Your judgment, reflexes, and decision-making skills will determine the ultimate profit you can earn from every treasure.

About This Game

Daylight is your chance to prepare. Nightfall is when the real trial begins.

Explore the world, gather resources, expand your settlement, and fortify your castle before the sun goes down. Because when darkness falls, the Void awakens.

Relentless creatures emerge from the darkness and descend upon your walls. What you build during the day must survive the night.

Trials of the Void is a cooperative survival and base-building game for up to four players, combining exploration, resource gathering, crafting, progression, and intense nighttime defense.

By day, venture into forests, caves, and forgotten lands in search of the resources you need to survive. Farm, mine, gather, and craft as you expand your settlement, improve your equipment, and unlock new technologies.

Strengthen your castle with upgraded walls and powerful siege weapons. Discover runes that permanently enhance your settlement, upgrade your tools and weapons, and decide how best to prepare for the battles ahead.

But daylight never lasts forever.

When night falls, the Void attacks. Each night brings increasingly dangerous waves of creatures determined to tear through your defenses and destroy everything you've built. Fight together, hold the walls, and survive until sunrise.

Every day gives you another chance to become stronger.

Every night asks the same question:

Did you prepare enough?

Features

  • Survive together in online co-op with up to four players.

  • Explore a handcrafted world filled with forests, caves, and hidden resources.

  • Gather, farm, mine, and craft to expand your settlement and unlock new technology.

  • Build and upgrade your defenses with stronger walls, storage, farms, wells, and siege weapons.

  • Defend your castle against increasingly dangerous waves of Void creatures every night.

  • Discover powerful runes that permanently enhance your settlement and unlock new progression paths.

  • Upgrade your arsenal with a variety of tools and weapons, each offering its own uses and upgrade paths.

  • Prepare by day. Survive by night. Explore and build while the sun is up, then fight together when darkness falls.

The Void is always watching.

Prepare before sunset... or become another Trial of the Void.

🧟 TRIMSON

TRIMSON is a system-driven zombie survival game where you deploy into infected zones, rescue survivors, gather critical resources, and return home to a settlement shaped by your actions.

Every deployment carries risk. Injuries and infections follow you home. Survivors can be lost. Resources are limited. The people you save can unlock new opportunities for your settlement—and the people you leave behind may be gone forever.

The world remembers what you do.

🚁 Deploy. Survive. Return.

Leave the safety of Trimson and enter dangerous towns, forests, facilities, and abandoned locations in search of survivors and supplies.

Once deployed, there is no simply returning home when things go wrong. Complete your objective, adapt to what happens in the field, and make it back alive.

🧍 Rescue Survivors

Every survivor matters.

The people you rescue become part of Trimson. Survivors can unlock vendors, missions, activities, and new opportunities while civilians react to the outcome of your deployments.

Who you save—and who you fail to save—becomes part of your playthrough.

🩸 Survive More Than the Infected

Combat is only one part of survival.

Bleeding, infection, poison, disease, and other status effects can turn a successful mission into a fight to stay alive. Search for medical supplies, plants, and resources before your condition becomes fatal.

And the infected aren't the only danger outside the walls. Wildlife inhabits the world too, and sometimes avoiding a fight is the smartest decision.

🧟 Face an Evolving Infection

Not every infected behaves the same.

Encounter increasingly dangerous mutations that can chase, overwhelm, ambush, strengthen other infected, and change the battlefield around you.

Learn what you're facing, decide when fighting is worth the risk, and prepare for threats far beyond the common infected.

🏚️ Build a Stronger Trimson

Your progress doesn't end when the mission does.

Gather resources, earn experience, improve your character, discover equipment, complete achievements, and bring survivors home to expand what's available inside Trimson.

Your settlement is more than a menu between missions—it's the community you're fighting to keep alive.

📖 Discover What Happened

Explore the world and recover hidden lore documenting the events that led to the outbreak.

Piece together the experiments, infections, people, and decisions behind the fall of the original Trimson—and uncover the truth behind what now stalks its ruins.

⚔️ Survive Horde Mode

Want to forget the rescue mission and just survive?

Take on increasingly dangerous waves of infected in Horde Mode. Kill enemies, earn currency, purchase equipment, manage your resources, and see how long you can survive as the pressure increases.

🎯 What TRIMSON Offers

  • System-driven zombie survival

  • Survivor rescue missions

  • A persistent settlement that reacts to your actions

  • Multiple infected variants with unique behaviors

  • Infection, bleeding, poison, disease, buffs, and other status effects

  • Resource gathering and crafting

  • Character progression

  • Wildlife encounters

  • Discoverable lore

  • Achievements and long-term progression

  • Horde Mode

  • Meaningful mission consequences

TRIMSON isn't about killing everything in your path.

Sometimes survival means fighting. Sometimes it means finding medicine. Sometimes it means risking your life for one more survivor.

And sometimes it means knowing when to walk away.

👤 Built by One Developer

TRIMSON is independently developed by a solo developer at Nacto Gaming Studios. From its interconnected survival systems and infected behaviors to its missions, settlement, progression, and world, TRIMSON is being built with a focus on player choice, consequences, and replayability.
